## Description

Replaces linear error correction terms in VECM with deep neural networks while retaining fractional integration memory parameters ($d$) to allocate capital across persistent cointegrated asset baskets.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon cointegrated asset allocation, multi-asset relative value strategies with slow mean-reversion persistence.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Macro Funds, Statistical Arbitrage Desks.

## Required data

Historical price series of cointegrated asset baskets, fractional differencing parameters, macroeconomic feature panels.

## Caveats

Neural network backpropagation inside fractional error correction loops requires stable gradient convergence.
